cafe: Could you make that coffee decaf?
Certainly. Shall I change the one you have already ordered?
Please. I forgot I have had two cups today.
No problem. I have not started making yours yet.
Is the fruit tea sweet?
It has dried apple in it, but no added sugar.
Could I smell it before I choose?
Of course. This tin has the blend we use.
I ordered the oat milk because it costs the same on the menu.
The printed menu is old. There is an extra charge now.
You should tell people before they order.
You are right. I will charge the price you saw.
I am taking these drinks on the bus.
You might need a carrier. There are three cups.
Will it fit in my shopping bag?
Better to carry it flat. I can hold the door for you.
I wanted the last slice for my daughter.
I have just put it aside for another customer.
Is there anything else without nuts?
The lemon cake should be suitable, but I will check the label.
This is sweeter than I expected.
Did you want it without the syrup?
Yes, I only asked for milk.
I must have misheard. The replacement will take a minute.
We booked the table by the window.
I can see your booking, but the group there is still eating.
We have a train to catch in an hour.
Then let me get another table ready right away.
Can we split the bill between three cards?
Yes. Are you dividing it equally?
Not quite. I only had the sandwich.
Tell me which items are yours and I will separate them.
Could we stay at the table until two?
It is reserved from one thirty.
We will finish before then if the food comes soon.
I will check with the kitchen and let you know.
We waited half an hour without being served.
I am sorry. Your order did not reach the kitchen.
We cannot stay any longer.
I understand. I will cancel it and return your payment.
travel: The machine gave me two single tickets.
Did you choose a return journey?
I thought I did. Can you change them?
Let us check the times before you pay for another ticket.
The number twelve is not stopping here today.
Oh, has the route changed?
There are roadworks. Use the stop outside the library.
Thanks. I would have waited here all morning.
I missed the connection because the first train was late.
Let me see both of your tickets.
Do I have to pay again?
You can take the next service with these tickets.
My suitcase came off the belt with a broken wheel.
Was it like that when you checked it in?
No. I took a photo before the flight.
Keep the photo and fill in this damage report.
The screen says delayed, but there is no new time.
The plane has not arrived from Paris yet.
Should we still go through security?
Yes. The gate will be announced after the aircraft lands.
Do you hire helmets with the bikes?
They are included. Try this one for size.
It feels rather loose.
I will get a smaller one and show you the route map.
We need a station entrance without stairs.
The east entrance has a ramp.
Is it open this evening?
Until the last train. I will mark it on your map.
The taxi price was higher than the estimate.
We spent a long time waiting in traffic.
I did not realise waiting time cost extra.
The rates are printed here. Let us look at them together.
I bought this ticket yesterday, but the event has been cancelled.
Did you buy it through our website?
Yes. Here is the confirmation.
The refund will go back to the card you used.
The coach is cheaper, but it arrives after midnight.
Could we stay with your cousin that night?
I have asked. Her spare room is free.
Then the late arrival should not be a problem.
hotel: I booked a twin room, not a double.
Let me check the message from your travel company.
We need two separate beds.
I can arrange that, but the room will take longer to prepare.
We are leaving before breakfast starts.
Would you like a small breakfast to take with you?
That would help. Can we collect it at five thirty?
I will leave it at reception with your room number.
The lift makes a loud noise next to our room.
I can offer you one on the floor above.
Will it be farther from the lift?
Yes, at the end of the corridor, facing the courtyard.
Our flight is at night. Can we keep the room all afternoon?
Late checkout is charged by the hour.
How much would four extra hours cost?
Let me work that out before you decide.
The charger you lent me does not fit.
Can you show me the connection on your phone?
It is this small oval one.
We have another cable for that. Keep the plug.
I put my laundry bag outside the door yesterday.
There was no room number on it.
Oh, I forgot to complete the label.
Describe the clothes and I will check the laundry room.
I need to move the booking to next month.
Your booking allows one free date change.
Do the new dates cost the same?
The weekend rate is higher, but the weekday rate is unchanged.
I think I left my key in a taxi.
We will stop that card from opening your room.
Can I get another straight away?
Yes, after I check your identification.
Could you send the bill to my company?
We normally send it to the guest first.
I need the company address printed on it.
Write the details here and we will update it.
The website said there was a swimming pool.
There is, but it is closed for repairs this week.
Nobody told us when we booked.
I am sorry. I will ask the manager what we can offer.
shopping: The sleeves are fine, but the shirt is tight across my shoulders.
You might prefer the next size up.
Will it be much longer?
Only a little. Take both sizes into the changing room.
I bought this jacket as a present, but it does not fit him.
Was it bought more than a month ago?
No, last Saturday. I have the receipt.
Then he can exchange it or choose something else.
The shelf label says these are on offer.
Only the green packets are reduced.
The labels are very close together.
I see what you mean. I will move them apart.
This kettle switches off before the water boils.
How long have you had it?
Just a week. I have only used it twice.
We can test it here and arrange a replacement.
My order says collected, but I have not been in.
Is anyone else allowed to collect it for you?
My sister has the same surname.
Let me check the signature before we do anything.
Can you send this gift without showing the price?
We can include a gift receipt instead.
Will my aunt still be able to exchange it?
Yes. The receipt has the details we need.
The voucher would not work on your website.
Were you buying something in the sale?
Yes. A pair of boots.
This offer cannot be used with sale prices. It says so on the back.
This second-hand bike looks almost new.
The owner used it for one summer.
Do you know when the brakes were checked?
We checked them when it arrived and kept the report.
Could you remove some of the packaging?
I can take off the outer plastic, but the glass needs its box.
That makes sense. I was worried about carrying so much rubbish.
We collect the plastic here for recycling.
I paid for the book in advance. Why is there an extra charge?
You selected delivery rather than collection.
I must have clicked the wrong option.
We can change it to collection before it is sent.
home: I seem to be doing the kitchen every week.
I thought you preferred that job.
Not really. I just finish before everyone else.
Let us write down the jobs and take turns.
The tap only leaks when the hot water is on.
That is useful to know. Did you take a video?
Yes. The floor was dry when the plumber came.
Send the video with the repair request.
May I keep your ladder until the weekend?
I need it on Friday morning.
I can return it on Thursday evening.
Leave it under the covered part of the garden.
A parcel with your address came to my flat.
Was my name on the label?
Yes, but the flat number was partly hidden.
Thanks for bringing it. I have been looking for it all day.
Could you let me know before you have a party?
Did we make too much noise last night?
I had an early shift and could not sleep.
I am sorry. Next time I will tell you and finish earlier.
Does the rent include all the bills?
Internet is included, but we share gas and electricity.
How much do those usually come to?
I can show you the bills from the last three months.
The moving van cannot park outside on Saturday.
Have you asked the neighbours to leave a space?
Yes, but the road will be closed for an event.
We may need to move the boxes on Friday instead.
Our electricity bill has doubled since December.
We have been using the small heater in the hall.
I did not think it used so much power.
Let us check it before we use it every evening.
The landlord wants us to sign a new agreement this week.
Have you read the new terms?
Some of them are different from last year.
Then we should ask for time to go through them.
Can you feed Milo while I am away?
I can do mornings, but not evenings.
My cousin can come after work.
Write down the times so nobody gives him dinner twice.
health: I booked online, but I have not had a confirmation.
What date did you choose?
Friday the eighteenth, in the afternoon.
I can see it here. The email address has a spelling mistake.
The evening exercise class is always full.
Have you tried booking earlier in the week?
I cannot book until I know my shifts.
Ask the organiser whether there is a waiting list.
I keep making evening plans and then feeling too tired to go.
Are you giving yourself any free evenings?
Only Sunday at the moment.
Perhaps your diary needs a few empty spaces.
The lunch menu says vegetarian, but I need the full ingredients.
Are you checking for something in particular?
Yes. Could you ask the kitchen rather than guess?
Certainly. I will bring you the written list.
I would like to join the walking group, but I walk quite slowly.
There are two routes on Sunday.
Does the shorter route have a leader too?
Yes, and both groups finish at the same cafe.
I brought my refill bottle, but the fountain is closed.
There is drinking water at the information desk.
Do I have to buy anything there?
No. They will fill your bottle for free.
We have three meetings straight after lunch.
Could we move one to tomorrow?
That would leave everyone time for a proper break.
I will ask the person who arranged the last meeting.
I paid for a class that was cancelled.
Did you get the message about a replacement date?
Yes, but I cannot attend that day.
Then contact the organiser and ask about your payment.
I planned to walk every day, but I only managed twice.
Were those two walks enjoyable?
Actually, yes. I went with a friend.
That sounds like a better start than a plan you dislike.
The new changing room sign points towards the stairs.
There is an accessible room beside reception.
I would not have found it from that sign.
I will report that. The directions need to include both rooms.
study: The book I need is due back today.
Someone has already renewed it.
Is there another copy in a different library?
I will check the other branches for you.
Do we answer every question or choose three?
The sheet says choose three from the first section.
I was looking at the second page.
Turn it over. The instructions continue at the top.
Our study group never starts on time.
People arrive whenever they finish work.
Could we spend the first ten minutes reading quietly?
Then late arrivals would not interrupt the discussion.
Could I hand the essay in on Monday?
You would need to explain why you need extra time.
My laptop is being repaired, but I have my notes.
Speak to the course office before the Friday deadline.
My feedback says I need clearer examples.
Have you compared your paragraph with the sample answer?
Not yet. I thought the comment was about spelling.
The sample may show what the teacher means.
I signed up for the wrong course level.
Have the classes started already?
Only one lesson has taken place.
Ask the office whether you can move to the other group.
Will you time my presentation?
How long should it be?
Five minutes, including the final example.
I will raise my hand when you have one minute left.
The sound keeps disappearing in the online lesson.
Can you hear me when I turn my camera off?
Yes, much better now.
I will send the slides afterwards so you can follow them.
The article quotes a study, but there is no link to it.
Is the study named at the end?
There is a short title and a date.
Try searching for both rather than quoting the article itself.
I have made a revision timetable for every hour.
Have you left time to eat and take breaks?
Not on the first version.
Change that before you decide the timetable is impossible.
work: Could we bring the team meeting forward an hour?
One person is travelling that morning.
Would an online call be easier?
Yes, if we send the documents in advance.
I am finishing three urgent jobs at once.
Which one has the earliest deadline?
The report, but customers keep calling.
I can cover the phone while you finish it.
I would like to work from home on Wednesdays.
Who would cover the front desk?
I have spoken to Dan. We could swap days.
Put the arrangement in writing so the team can see it.
These instructions mention a button that is not on my screen.
Which version of the software are you using?
The one installed this morning.
Then the guide needs updating. I will show you the new steps.
We promised delivery by Friday, but one part has not arrived.
Have you told the customer?
Not yet. I was hoping it would arrive today.
Give them an update now rather than leave them waiting.
The new colleague has not received a door pass.
She cannot get in before reception opens.
Could someone meet her outside tomorrow?
I start early. I can help until the pass arrives.
I think we misunderstood each other yesterday.
I thought you were asking me to redo everything.
I only meant the last two pages.
That is a relief. I will change those this afternoon.
Some figures in the report are still estimates.
Then we should mark them clearly.
Will that make the report look unfinished?
It will make it easier to read the figures correctly.
We enter the same address into three different forms.
Could we copy it from the first one?
I tried, but the boxes are different.
Show me an example. There may be a simpler way.
I cannot find the notes for the project you are handing over.
They are in the shared folder under the client name.
Which file has the latest changes?
The one dated Tuesday. I will rename it more clearly.
technology: I changed my password and now the phone will not sign in.
Is the phone still using the saved password?
It fills the box automatically.
Remove that saved entry and enter the new password yourself.
The document link works for me, but not for the client.
Did you share it with their exact email address?
I used the address from an old message.
Ask which account they are using before changing the access.
My backup finished, but several folders are empty.
Did the files finish copying before you unplugged the drive?
I closed the lid when the screen went dark.
Let us compare the folders before deleting anything.
I turned off notifications, but the app still shows a red number.
That is a separate setting for the app icon.
I thought one switch covered everything.
The options are confusing. I will show you where it is.
The update moved my favourite tools.
They are under the small menu on the right.
Can I put them back on the main screen?
Some of them. There is an option to choose your shortcuts.
The connection drops whenever I move into the back room.
Does it happen on your phone as well?
Yes, but both devices work near the front door.
Tell support those details. It may help them find the problem.
The website will not let me reject just the extra cookies.
There should be a way to change the choices.
I can only see an accept button.
Try the settings link before agreeing to anything.
Making the text bigger has hidden the save button.
Can you scroll further down the page?
There is no more space below it.
That needs reporting. Larger text should not block the controls.
The tool wrote a summary of a book it seems not to know.
What makes you think that?
It gave two characters different names.
Use the book itself to check the summary before sharing it.
I cancelled the subscription, but another payment is due.
When does the current period end?
Tomorrow. The message only says cancellation requested.
Ask for written confirmation of the final date.
environment: Our neighbour puts plastic bags in the glass bin.
Perhaps they have not seen the new collection leaflet.
Could we put a copy by the bins?
A picture of what goes where might be more useful.
Water is running from the tap near the playground.
I reported it yesterday, but nobody has come.
Did you include the exact location?
Only the park name. I will add the gate number.
The tree planting day is next Saturday.
Who looks after the trees after that?
I have not heard anything about watering.
We should ask before we put them in the ground.
We filled all the bags before reaching the far end of the park.
Do we have more bags in the van?
Yes, but there is no space to leave the full ones.
Call the collection team and agree where to put them.
I would like a stall at the local market.
Do you need electricity for what you sell?
Only a small light.
Ask about the connection fee as well as the table price.
The shared tool shelf is full of things nobody uses.
Have the owners labelled them?
Some tools do not have names on them.
Let us make a list before moving anything.
We bought reusable cups, but people keep taking them home.
Perhaps they think the cups are included in the drink price.
There is no sign saying they should return them.
A clear return point would help too.
The proposed bike route ends at a busy junction.
Is there a crossing nearby?
Yes, but it is around the corner.
The route map should show the safe way across.
We only received survey replies from people using the website.
Some older residents asked for paper copies.
Could the library give them out?
And collect them, so nobody has to go online.
Two groups want the same small grant.
Do they know how the money will be awarded?
One group thinks it is first come, first served.
We need to publish the rules before making a choice.
